summary.text: Mike Gambrell is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 4, which covers Abbeville and Anderson Counties, serving since May 24, 2016.
He previously served in the S.C. House from 2007 to 2016.

paragraphs.text: Gambrell was born on January 10, 1958, in Belton, and his official page lists a B.S. from Clemson University in 1980.
He was chief of the Friendship Fire Department from 1990 to 2006 and sat on the Anderson County EMS Commission from 2002 to 2006.
He served in the S.C. House from 2007 until May 24, 2016, and has served in the Senate since then.
His committees are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Banking and Insurance, Family and Veterans' Services, Finance, and Medical Affairs.
